programs.description: Unaware of their common parentage, two siblings live independent lives after their parents' divorce. However, destiny reunites them under unexpected circumstances.
A fierce college rivalry turns deadly when one group embrace Satanism, unleashing terror by killing their rivals one by one.
Kavitha, a struggling woman, goes through a difficult time while repaying her brother's debts. Later, she takes up an acting job for a commercial and things change drastically.
In Saint Petersburg, Russian author Fyodor Dostoyevsky's life unfolds. When he focuses on his romance with Anna, who eventually becomes his wife.
The Kauravas and Pandavas, two rival families, battle for supremacy in Hastinapur. With Krishna's support, the Pandavas strive to emerge victorious.
A young man tries to break away from his poverty-ridden life as a barber's son and hopes to study further. His father, however, refuses to send him away and threatens to commit suicide.
Distinguished artists and musicians present enchanting performances interpreting the rich culture of India during the 2025 edition of the Soorya Festival.
Sidharthan and his wife, Renjini, are at odds with each other over his conformist manners. During an argument, she falls from the balcony and slips into a coma, which leads him to lose his sanity.
Amarnath, a police officer, tries to settle a communal riot that has taken place among the fishermen. However, he faces many challenges as he strives to bring the criminals to justice.
Sam Alex, a police officer, resorts to alcohol to ease the pain of his family's death. However, his life turns around when he is called to investigate a series of murders showing a similar pattern.
Four friends are nothing but timid, petty thieves trying to get by for a living. Things change drastically for them when they get caught in the act of stealing.
Vindhyan often reminisces about his childhood infatuation with Neelima who now resides in America. However, to his discontent, she is in love with another man, Shivpal.
A newlywed couple rent a house to start fresh, but live in constant fear that their families, who oppose their union, might track them down and force them apart.
Siddharth often has problems with his wife Anjali owing to his short temper. Things take an unexpected turn when they get involved with a gangster.
Rafael, a singer, discovers that he is adopted and goes on a quest to find his birth parents. However, things take a turn when he comes across a vengeful Varma.
Retirees Omanakuttan Pilla, Cherian Thomas and Mahendran Thambi decide to set up a drama troupe in order to stay active. However, they endure several hurdles and incidents in the process.
Kuttan strikes it rich after selling a cursed statue. However, his luck changes when the statue mysteriously returns, bringing chaos into his household.
A reputable doctor embarks on a journey of redemption years after his actions led to the death of a college mate who used to be a poor villager's son.
After an elephant saves him from an accident in childhood, Krishna becomes fond of elephants. His life changes when he decides to adopt Arjunan, a severely injured elephant.
